title: Scheduling sprint notes — Anya (28 Mar 2026)
content:
Morning sprint — quick brain dump and checklist

Top goals for today (block/disconnect windows):
- Clear inbox of scheduling threads by EOD (aim: <= 6 open threads)
- Lock interview slots for Eng PM set (panel + hiring manager)
- Follow up with 3 high-priority candidates re: take-home task scheduling
- Reconfirm timezone + dial-in for global panel (Emilia in CET, Tom in PST)

Timeblocks (my calendar):
- 08:30–09:15: triage Slack + email (catch cancellations)
- 09:30–11:00: batch scheduling — send invites, proposer windows, buffer times
- 11:00–11:30: quick sync with Ravi — interview packet status
- 13:00–15:00: live reschedules + candidate prep notes (block for last-minute changes)
- 16:00–17:00: wrap, update tracker, daily metrics

Candidate follow-ups (priority order) — quick scripts and next steps:
1) Cand: M.R. (final on-site request) — status: waiting on candidate for availability
   - Send 2 options: Tue 4/6 10:00–11:30 PT, Thu 4/8 13:00–15:00 PT
   - Use template: short reminder + attach interview agenda + 30-min buffer note
   - If no reply in 48h -> ping recruiter (Maya) to escalate

2) Cand: S.J. (take-home accepted, scheduling panel) — status: needs panel availability
   - Block tentative 1.5h on hiring manager + 2 interviewers; propose 3 windows
   - Note: SJ prefers afternoons (PDT) — avoid 09:00–11:00 their local

3) Cand: L.W. (international — CET) — status: confirmation pending calendar invite timezone
   - Confirm: invite should show 15:00 CET (which is 06:00 PT). Offer alternative 09:00 CET.
   - Add dial-in + ICS with explicit timezone string "Europe/Berlin" in subject to reduce confusion

Templates to use (short-hand):
- "Quick availability check" = "Hey [Name], do any of these times work for you? [opt1], [opt2], [opt3]. If none, send 2 windows that do. Would prefer to lock this in by EOD Friday. — Anya"
- "Panel confirmation" = "Confirmed: [Date/time w/tz]. Panelists: [names]. Please review attached agenda and share any conflicts by EOD prior. Zoom link + prep doc attached."

Rules / heuristics I keep in head (for consistency):
- Always propose 3 windows across 2 different days to reduce back-and-forth
- Use 30-min buffer before/after panel for travel/prep (even if virtual)
- For international candidates, mirror their preferred daypart when possible
- When candidate timezone ambiguous -> ask explicitly with: "What city/timezone are you in currently?"

Handling cancellations + late reschedules: quick flow
- Candidate cancels <24h before: offer 2 alternatives within next 5 business days and offer 1 earlier opening if exists
- Panelist cancels: notify candidate right away, propose fallback interviewer or reschedule depending on role seniority (if HM cancels -> reschedule)
- If multiple cancellations -> escalate to Ravi for re-paneling decisions

Open blockers & notes to resolve with team:
- Need final panel list for Eng PM (still waiting on Sam to confirm SRE interviewer) — action: Ravi to follow up by noon
- Recruiting pack for L4 IC is missing updated rubric — link to doc in JIRA REC-487 (Maya to update)

Quick wins I can do today:
- Standardize subject line: "[Role] — Interview (candidate last, date, tz)" to reduce confusion in threads
- Add two canned responses to Slack workflow for common reschedules

Daily metrics to track (manual, quick snapshot):
- Threads started today: __
- Threads closed today: __
- New interviews booked: __
- No-shows / cancels: __

Evening wrap: what to jot before leaving
- Update tracker with final times and panelists (sheet link in JIRA comment)
- Move any unscheduled high-priority threads into "follow-up tomorrow" and flag as urgent
- Short note for next shift: 3 things to finish first thing (explicit bullets)

Random reminders / personal hacks:
- If candidate timezone unclear and they answer with city -> quickly google "city timezone" and paste into invite (helps with Apple/Outlook conversions)
- When scheduling between widely different timezones, propose a rotating inconvenience pattern (if we ask candidate to do late evening this time, next round offer earlier for them)

Questions I want to ask in weekly sync:
- Can we add 15-minute buffer auto-insert to panel invites via calendar template? (makes life easier)
- Are interviewers ok with 30-min prep buffer being optional? Some prefer 15. Poll this week.

Done-for-now checklist (tick when done):
- [ ] Send M.R. options
- [ ] Propose SJ windows to panelists
- [ ] Confirm L.W. timezone and send updated invite
- [ ] Quick sync with Ravi at 11:00
- [ ] Post daily update in #recruiting-coord by 17:30

Notes to self: keep messages short, always include timezone, and be decisive on reschedule policy. If stuck, escalate early.

-- end of sprint notes --
